text: I now give the floor to his excellency
Kim Seong Yong, Vice Minister of Foreign
Affairs of the Democratic People's
Republic of Korea.
Mr. President,
Mr. Secretary General,
distinguished delegate,
allow me first of all to extend my
congratulations to you, Mr. Khaled
Rahman on your election as the president
of the 81st session of the UN General
Assembly. I am confident that your ap
stewardship will lead this session to an
excellent outcome.
Mr. President,
last year we meaningfully celebrated the
80th founding anniversary of the United
Nations.
As we marked the watershed in UN
history, reviewing its past 80 years and
looking ahead into the future, mankind
ardently desired and aspired to put an
immediate end to the current chaos of
international relations
and regain peace and stability.
Unfortunately, however, what the world
witnessed every day for the last one
year was a harsh reality rampant with
unprecedented mutual distrust and
confrontation, infringement on
sovereignty and military conflicts that
led to extreme unrest and disorder
globally.
The new year started with a most
despicable world startling act of state
sponsored terrorism followed by
worldwide outbreaks of other appalling
instance and events which anyone with a
common sense and knowledge can hardly
imagine. Crisis causing insecurity and
instability increased further with the
wars and bloody conflicts.
The effects of a disasterprone abnormal
climate gave rise to a succession of
extreme high temperature, droughts,
heavy rains and floods in many countries
and regions seriously threatening the
survival of mankind. This coupled with
the spread of communicable diseases and
hike in oil prices worsened the
socioeconomic crisis.
Humanity desires that the United Nations
should fulfill its mission and
responsibility as an organization
established to save succeeding
generations from the scorch of war.
Regrettably, however, the organization
still fails to recover from functional
paralysis
owing to a high-handedness and
unilateralism of a handful of countries
pursuing only chauvinistic interests.
All the crisis the international
community is faced with point one clear
fact
that infringement
on sovereignty threat to security
interests and denial of right to
development of other countries
are bound to breed regional instability
and crisis and lead to aggression and
war.
In order to overcome all the existing
crisis and challenges and promote peace,
security and sustainable development,
all member states
should seek appropriate solutions to
problems while strictly complying with
intrinsic purposes and principles of the
UN charter and giving priority to unity
and cooperation among nations.
Mr. President.
The historic 9inth Congress of the
Workers Party of Korea was held with a
splendor in February this year in
Pyongyang, the capital city of the
Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
The Congress reviewed with a pride the
achievements made over the past five
years and set out new innovative goals
for overall development in the next
stage. During the last five years, the
existence and development of humankind
was severely constrained by the global
pandemic, abnormal weather conditions,
geopolitical confrontation, and the
intelling economic crisis. They were
harsh times for our state.
Yet, we have thoroughly and consistently
maintained the characteristic principle
and approach of self-reliance. Our
resilience grew stronger. We overcame
all difficulties and challenges before
us and ultimately made the remarkable
advances by leaps and bounds.
The five-year plan for the development
of the national economy was successfully
accomplished. The economic foundation
for production boost was reinforced.
Numerous monumental projects were
completed. policies for the people that
our government invariably pursues are
implemented at higher level. We are
seeing the outward trade of a
comprehensive development conducive to a
simultaneous and balanced growth in all
sectors, fields and regions of the
country. As the firsthand witnesses of
the above realities, all our citizens
have become all the more confident that
the path we have trodden is the most
accurate path and the self-reliance and
self- sustenance of our choice are the
shest shortcut to prosperity.
Under the unique leadership of comrade
Kim Jong-un, president of the state of
use of the DPRK, our people have now
confidently embarked on new massive
projects aimed at building on the
successes in pioneering a year of a
comprehensive development and leading it
to a new heights.
The path ahead of us is laden with a
numerous challenges and difficulties
presented by inhuman acts of a certain
forces that disfavor the DPRK's very
existence let alone her development. Yet
we will surely attain all that we plant
relying entirely on our own efforts
regardless of changes and the situation.
This is the confidence that every Korean
is assured of
Mr. President,
the sovereignty, security, interests,
and territorial integrity of sovereign
states are ruthlessly trampled upon an
international law and order feebly
collapsed due to the unilateral
high-handedness and tyranny of a
hegemanical state. Such a grim reality
in international relations teaches us a
serious lesson.
A lesson that fair advocacy and earnest
desire for compliance with the law and
order alone can hardly defend anything.
Like in other parts of the world, a
serious landscape of confrontation
between justice and injustice and
between hegemonic forces and independent
forces is being witnessed in Northeast
Asia this year.
The Korean Peninsula and its vicinity in
particular are faced with extreme
instability and further aggravated
tension on a level different from that
of last year due to the persistent
hostility towards the DPRK and ever
increasing military confrontation of the
US and its followers.
The US Japan ROK military alliance
unmistakably aimed at the DPRK is being
evolved by the United States into a more
offensive and aggressive military block
with a nuclear element. The US is
conspiring with its allies to
systematically amend and update the
anti-DPRK nuclear war scenarios and to
steadily cultivate and master their
performance capability through
provocative war rehearsals of all hues
and military buildup. This year alone,
the US staged a series of bilateral and
multilateral military exercises,
including Freedom Shield and Freedom
Edge, simulating a real war scenario. It
didn't even bother to cover up its
dangerous attempt at military
confrontation against the DPRK.
The US has approved and encouraging
souls ambition to possess nuclear power
submarines while relocating and
deploying different military hardware
including the latest missiles and drones
on the Korean peninsula and its
vicinity. The current military
inclination is further aggravating the
already vulnerable security in landscape
in the region. On the other hand, Japan,
an A-class war criminal that inflicted
untold sufferings and disasters upon
mankind in the last century, is taking
advantage of the present international
turbulence. It accelerates it its
attempts at rearmament with an
unprecedented commitment, including the
revision of the peace constitution,
abandonment of exclusive defense,
reformation of the military structure
and arms buildup. Such actions are
casting war clouds of the entire region.
Under the sign board of a count
capability, Japan has buckled down to
the development and possession of a long
range attack weapons that put
neighboring countries within a striking
range. Its ambition runs counter to its
obligations as a defeated nation. They
in shameless disregard of the UN charter
and pose a great challenge to global
peace.
The global military and political
context is worsening day by day and the
unlimited abuse of power has become
uncommon place. Under such
circumstances, the risky military threat
of the US, Japan and ROK go beyond
precedent and continue to break the
worst of records in their scale,
intensity, nature, and dangers creating
security instability on the Korean
peninsula on a level different from
previous years.
Nevertheless, no physical conflict has
occurred on and around the Korean
peninsula, a hot spot of the world, and
the security index is being maintained
at a higher level than any other part of
the globe. We owe to the fact that the
DPRK has a war deterrent in place
powerful enough to break anyone's will
to start a war of aggression against the
DPRK and that we are thoroughly
containing and managing the hostile
forces intention to use force.
Thus, the regional balance of power
maintained by the DPRK's self-defensive
capabilities effectively copes the risk
of an armed conflict.
No one can deny such an obvious fact. It
further highlighted the immutable truth
that just power means national
sovereignty and prestige and fundamental
guarantee of peace and stability.
The head of a state of the Democratic
People's Republic of Korea stated that
our national sovereignty and security
have firmly been ensured by virtue of a
great strength so far and will
invariably be so in the years ahead.
The DPRK is a nuclear deterrent is the
absolute might and irregistable force
designed from A to Jet to safeguard the
sovereignty, security and peace against
aggression and threat from outside.
I'd like to reiterate the official
position of the DPRK government, the
status of the Democratic People's
Republic of Korea as a nuclear weapons
state that has been uncompromisingly and
permanently fixed both fiscally and
legally with absolutely no turning point
can never be reversed in any
circumstances or by any means. No matter
how hard and loudly the hostile forces
may deny in chorus with all sorts of
rhetoric, the DPRK will continue to
strictly control and manage every
external threat by D of her supremacy in
overwhelming strength and bema faithful
and committed to our mission as a
responsible nuclear weapons state to
firmly defend the national sovereignty
and fundamental interest and to
guarantee peace and security of the
region and beyond.
Mr. President,
larger scale natural calamities claimed
tens of thousands of lives in different
parts of the world this year. The
international community came to realize
once again that climate change is a
pressing issue that calls for joint
action.
Artificial intelligence and other new
cutting edge technology are transforming
every domain of human life offering
great opportunities. But at the same
time they also carry risks of being
misused for sinister purposes.
Highly volatile present year urgently
calls for strengthened UN capable of
handling challenges and crisis facing
humanity in conformity with a common
interest of mankind.
The most pressing issue to be addressed
is none other than building the UN into
the UN for all faithful to the purposes
and principles enshrined in the charter
and fully guaranteed of impartiality and
objectivity in the face of the arbitrary
practices of the anti- peace forces that
are abusing the UN as a tool for
implementing the hegemonic strategy.
The United Nations should no longer be
misused for the sinister political
purposes of a specific forces. The
United Nations should firmly secure its
authority and future by promoting
equality and cooperation among sovereign
states.
It's about time the UN undertook a
reform.
Not the reform centered on specific
countries, but the one aimed at
democratization of the United Nations in
the true sense of the word so that the
organization would represent the views
and interests of the entire membership
evenly and equally.
Gone are the days when an individual
member state unilaterally imposed its
will on the rest of the world and
dominated the international political
arena. Instead, multilateralism and
multipolarization have emerged as an
irresistible aspiration and trend of the
times based on justice and equality.
The DPRK will always be with the
anti-imperialist independent countries
aspiring after the building of a just
and peaceful world and is committed to
undertaking the historic mission of
leading the movement for global
independence under the uplifted banner
of independence.
Mr. President,
this year marks the 35th year of the
DPRK's entry into the UN.
The DPRK joined the UN out of the desire
to defend the peace and security of the
region and the world and to achieve
common prosperity of mankind together
with the entire UN membership. To this
end, we have remained faithful to the
purposes and principles of the UN
charter.
As a UN member state, the DPRK
government maintains its invariable
stand to actively work towards the
establishment of a genuine international
justice and a new fair international
order in compliance with the UN charter
and international law.
In particular, I affirm that the DPRK
government led by the present head of
state of the Democratic People's
Republic of Korea will direct positive
efforts to promote international
justice, co-rossperity, peace and
security of the region and beyond while
firmly defending her national
sovereignty, security interests and the
right development.
Thank you.
I thank the vice minister foreign
affairs of the Democratic People's
Republic of Korea.
